暂停会取消尚未开始的触发。已进入会话的任务需要在会话中停止。: Pausing cancels triggers that have not started. Stop active tasks in their conversations.
重置后旧密钥立即失效，已接收的事件保留。: Resetting immediately revokes the old secret. Accepted events are retained.

上一任务或后台命令仍在运行，本次定时触发已跳过。: The previous task or a background command is still running. This scheduled occurrence was skipped.
未找到已确认的执行回执，请检查会话；系统不会自动重试。: No confirmed execution receipt was found. Check the conversation; the system will not retry automatically.

从账户菜单或云端任务面板进入“自动任务”。选择项目、模型和任务内容，设置单次、每: Open Automations from the account menu or Cloud tasks. Choose a project, model and task instructions, then select once, daily, weekly or a five-field Cron expression. Repeating tasks follow the selected IANA time zone, including daylight saving changes; one-off dates use the browser’s local time. New automations are disabled unless you explicitly enable them.
每次触发创建独立会话，约每十秒检查一次。前一次任务、待答请求或后台命令尚未结束时: Each trigger creates its own conversation. The server checks about every ten seconds. Scheduled occurrences are recorded as skipped while an earlier task, unanswered question or background command remains active; webhook and manual events wait in acceptance order. Missed periods during downtime coalesce into one occurrence rather than a full historical backlog. Pausing or deleting cancels unstarted events; stop accepted tasks in their conversations.
Webhook 使用独立 Bearer 密钥和 X-Lester-Event-I: Webhooks accept JSON objects up to 32 KiB with a separate Bearer secret and X-Lester-Event-ID header. Secrets appear only at creation or reset; the server stores only a hash. Send over HTTPS and store the secret securely on the sender. Reusing an event ID with the same data returns its original record; changed data is rejected. Payloads cannot change models, projects or permissions. This is a generic inbound interface, without outbound callbacks or native application adapters.
默认权限会等待操作确认，自动审批和完全访问需主动选择，范围始终限于已授权 Com: Standard permissions wait for operation approval. Auto approval and full access require an explicit choice and remain inside the authorized Computer. Answering questions never approves execution. History shows the last twenty triggers and conversation links. Uncertain starts only check the original receipt and never rerun automatically. Each account supports one hundred automations; each endpoint accepts thirty new events per minute and twenty pending events. Duplicate deliveries do not consume a new-event slot.
已有部署先备份并停止 API 写入与活跃任务，按顺序补齐迁移至 000027_a: For existing deployments, back up and stop API writes and active tasks, apply all missing migrations through 000027_automations.up.sql in order, then rebuild API and Web together. Fresh Compose databases initialize 001–027; never delete volumes to upgrade. Rolling back 027 removes automation definitions and trigger records, without undoing operations or deleting conversations/files. The executor and scheduler still run in API; restarts do not automatically resume old tools.
待答问题固定在聊天框上方，逐题显示单选、多选和推荐项，多题可核对后统一提交。推荐: Pending questions stay above the composer, one at a time, with single choice, multiple choice and recommendations. Review multiple answers before sending them together. Recommendations are never preselected; extra text and selections are both retained. Within the card, number keys select options and arrow keys navigate question tabs; Enter in an answer inserts a new line. Stop remains available, and submitted answers remain in the conversation receipt.
当前支持定时任务和通用入站 Webhook。跨会话 Memory、外部应用原生连: Scheduled tasks and generic inbound webhooks are supported. Cross-conversation Memory, native external-app connectors and a standalone Worker are not implemented. Agents can use installed Playwright for browser automation in Computer, without a dedicated browser interface. Execution remains in API and interrupted tools are not automatically replayed.
操作结果未确认，请刷新后检查。: The result is unconfirmed. Refresh and check before trying again.
项目成果加载失败，请重试: Could not load project deliverables. Try again.
项目成果查询无效，请刷新后重试: Invalid project query. Refresh and try again.
无法打开成果，请到来源会话检查文件或重试。: Cannot open this deliverable. Check the file in its source conversation or try again.
汇总项目会话中已登记的网页和文档；预览时检查当前文件。: Registered pages and documents from project conversations. Current files are checked when opened.
试试其他关键词或成果类型。: Try different keywords or another type.
在项目会话中生成并登记网页或文档后，会出现在这里。其他文件可在来源会话中查看。: Pages and documents appear here once generated and registered in a project conversation. Other files remain available in their source conversation.
站点页面加载失败: Could not load the sites page
部署后生成公开链接，可在已发布站点中下线。只选择你希望分享的页面和资源。: Publishing creates a public link. Take it offline in Published sites. Select only the pages and resources you want to share.
点击侧栏的项目名称进入项目工作台，箭头负责展开或收起会话，＋负责在项目中新建任务: Click a project name in the sidebar to open its workspace. The chevron expands or collapses conversations; + starts a task in that project. Deliverables open by default, with a Conversations tab and project rules at the top right. Existing task routes and drafts are preserved.
成果页汇总项目内各会话已登记的 HTML 网页和 Markdown 文档，支持搜: Deliverables brings together registered HTML pages and Markdown documents from project conversations. Search names, file paths or source conversations, filter by type and load more pages. Registration does not prove current file availability or review. Preview and continue first check the source file. Continuing returns to the source conversation with a file reference and the existing draft, without sending.
已发布站点单独管理公开发布记录；从项目进入时会带上项目筛选，返回时回到该项目工作: Published sites manages public publication records separately. Opening it from a project selects that project; Back returns to its workspace. The workspace only aggregates records: files stay in their original conversation directories, without automatic copying or publishing. No new database migration is needed; existing deployments rebuild API and Web together.
在工作区首页选择模型和 Agent，写下目标、约束和想要的交付物。输入为空时显示: Choose a model and Agent on the workspace home, then describe your goal, constraints and deliverables. An empty input shows document, table and web examples; with a draft or attachment, examples move under “Try a task”. Examples only fill a draft; the conversation is created when you send the first message. The book icon replays onboarding, and the artifact icon opens published Published sites.
已发布站点集中查看公开发布记录。会话内的文件和成果默认留在工作区；自动预览不会自: Site management shows published content. Conversation files stay private in your workspace by default; automatic preview does not publish them.
发布完成后在已发布站点中打开网址。需要更新时重新发布；不再分享时取消发布。工作区: Open the URL in site management after publishing. Republish to update or unpublish to stop sharing. Conversations and source files remain in your workspace.
点击项目名称查看成果和会话，点「新任务」或侧栏 ＋ 准备任务，发送第一条消息才创: Click a project name to view its deliverables and conversations. Choose New task or the sidebar + to prepare a task; only the first explicit message creates a conversation. Search and the chevron still help you find earlier work.
普通文件自动处理；命令由独立 AI 审批，不确定时请你确认。: Handle ordinary files automatically; an independent AI reviews commands and asks you when uncertain.
权限更改立即用于当前任务的后续操作: Permission changes apply immediately to the current task’s remaining operations
当前任务权限读取失败，请检查状态。: Could not read the current task’s permissions. Check the status.
权限修改结果未确认，请检查状态；不会自动重试。: The permission change is unconfirmed. Check the status; it will not be retried automatically.
自动审批不可用，请你确认这次操作。: Automatic review is unavailable. Please review this operation.
审批输入过大或无效，请你确认这次操作。: The review input is too large or invalid. Please review this operation.
自动审批超时或返回格式无效，请你确认这次操作。: Automatic review timed out or returned an invalid response. Please review this operation.
自动审批会使用当前任务的模型进行独立审查；允许后执行，拒绝则停止该操作，不确定或: Auto approval uses the current task’s model in a separate review call. Allowed operations execute; denied operations stop. Uncertainty or review failure asks for your confirmation. Sensitive files still require confirmation, and reviews never expand Plan or Computer boundaries.
运行中修改权限会立即作用于当前任务尚未开始的操作，已排队任务保留发送时的权限。命: Changing permissions during a run immediately affects operations that have not started. Queued tasks keep their submitted permissions. Command approval cards also offer “Full access for this task”.
已有部署需备份并停止 API 写入与活跃任务，按顺序补齐迁移至 000028_p: For an existing installation, back up and stop API writes and active tasks, apply all missing migrations through 000028_permission_reviews.up.sql in order, then rebuild API and Web together. New Compose databases initialize 001–028; do not delete data volumes.
在当前步骤结束后补充这段文字，不停止任务。: Add this text after the current step finishes, without stopping the task.
发送后排队，当前任务完成后开始。: Sending queues this message until the current task finishes.
任务运行时，发送或按 Enter 会排队下一任务；输入文字后可点击“补充当前任务: While a task is running, Send or Enter queues the next task. After typing, choose Add to current task to add text after the complete tool batch, without interrupting or replaying commands or approving Plan. Adjustments accept text only; attachments and @ references must be queued, retaining the accepted model, permissions and materials. The Agent decides whether each new task needs planning.
对话页集中展示消息与成果。右上角“更多会话选项”可打开会话回顾、上下文概览和过程: Conversations focus on messages and results. More conversation options in the upper-right opens recap, context overview and process display. Answered questions, commands, file changes, approvals and processed messages are grouped under Execution details. Pending questions, approvals and unsettled background commands stay visible separately.
会话回顾、上下文概览和过程显示位于右上角“更多会话选项”。: Recap, context overview and process display are in More conversation options in the upper-right.
上下文概览区分已受理材料与待发送材料，不代表完整模型请求。默认对话展示最终回复、: Context overview distinguishes accepted materials from draft materials; it is not a complete model request. Conversations show final replies, current output and actual problems by default. Interim narration, tool records and context organization are available in Execution details. Show execution process in More conversation options displays the full process for this conversation; it does not change model context or operation permissions.
还没有会话，发送一个目标开始吧。: No conversations yet. Send a goal to get started.
从侧栏打开“最近会话”，跨项目按最近活动查看会话；每条显示当前所属项目，可按会话: Open Recent conversations in the sidebar to browse conversations across projects by latest activity. Each entry shows its current project. Search by conversation title or project name and select an entry to return to that conversation. Browsing or switching conversations never sends a draft or starts a task automatically.
在“最近会话”面板选择“任务状态”，可查看每个会话的最近任务，筛选进行中、需处理: In Recent conversations, select Task status to see the latest task in each conversation and filter active, needs-attention or finished tasks. Open the original conversation to review a plan, confirm an operation or answer a question; the list never approves or reruns tasks. Result counts mean registration only, not acceptance. Background commands can keep running after the Agent reply ends and are listed separately; unconfirmed command states still need inspection.
从账户菜单或任务状态面板进入“自动任务”。选择项目、模型和任务内容，设置单次、每: Open Automations from the account menu or the Task status panel. Select a project, model and task, then schedule a one-off, daily, weekly or five-field Cron execution. Repeating tasks use the selected IANA time zone and follow daylight saving time; one-off times are saved from the browser’s local time. Definitions are disabled by default and run on schedule only after you enable them.
